definitions.classes: all_fail: all five soil-competent arms (Spcrm H Hmask P T) fail; all_success: none fails; choice: mixed. Sprigid not used for the class.
definitions.speed_step: route start speed (speeds[0] of the picked route) minus body vx at frame 60
definitions.heading_step: route start heading minus chassis yaw at frame 60 (deg, wrapped)
definitions.terrain_ahead: heights from the v2 grid every 0.5 m; gain_Lm = h(L) - h(0); grade_Lm = atan(gain/L); maxup_Lm = max uphill grade over 1 m segments within L; head_ = straight line along the frame-60 yaw, route_ = along the picked route
definitions.steep: grid cell slope > 15.0 deg (central difference over +-2 cells, 0.625 m baseline); 21 % of arena cells
definitions.sinkage: collector formula (tyre radius minus spindle height above TerrainMap at the reconstructed spindle xy), max over wheels; frame-60 value = frame 59 of the pass-1 extra (last recorded row)
definitions.stall_onset: first frame >= 60 starting 20 consecutive frames with |vx| < 0.3 and throttle > 0.3; time from the branch
definitions.slip: per-frame median over the four wheels of |slip ratio| from crm_extra (collector: (omega r - v_wheel)/max(|v_wheel|, 0.1))
definitions.t_term: (frames - 60) * 0.05 s: time from the branch to the end of the recording

Q2_onset.early_spin_share_by_step_note: drives with crm_extra only: every failure + the sampled successes, so the pooled share over-weights failures; see the split by outcome

logit_soil5_fail_on_vx60_apprmaxgrade_he.note: se ignores the 5-arm clustering (x5 rows per group), inflate by ~sqrt(5) for a conservative read
